body.x: iRING(www.iringshop.com) introduced "iRING Dock," and IT product wall hanger, at CES 2015, which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas.iRING Dock is a set product of iRING, attached to the back of the smartphone. When iRING is inserted into iRING Dock, it functions as the wall hanger.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), CES 2015 is the world's largest IT and consumer electronicsexhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot. This year, AVING News is using smartphones for news reporting, in line with the trend of one-person media.→ Go to CES 2015 Special Page
